reason: The weighty bills are exactly what q25 names. Row 1 (Student Rights Law amendment 12, 2026, about half the weight) and row 4 allow separate study tracks for men and women in higher education. Rows 2-3, 5, 7-10 set separate bathing beaches or separate bathing hours at nature sites. Rows 11, 15 allow gender-separated cultural events, and row 13 (would ban separation) is correctly labeled away. Swimming hours, events and study programs, with the price of limited access for one sex, cover more than 95% of the weight. Rows 6 (military service by religious belief) and 12/14 (Council for Higher Education access) are light and only loosely related, which does not matter.
